claims.claim: Figure1B depicts a predicted catechol branch through CatA, CatB, CatC and PcaD. It also depicts benzoate entry, the protocatechuate branch and downstream PcaIJ/PcaF steps.
claims.level: Genome annotation/pathway model, not four purified-enzyme assays
claims.graph_use: Context only; do not replace exact native four-member boundary or attribute A1501 evidence to P. putida complexes.

claims.claim: A1501-derived pcaD insertion mutant A1603 loses growth on catechol, benzoate and 4-hydroxybenzoate; complementation restores benzoate growth, reported without displayed data.
qualifiers: A1603 is nonpolar suicide-plasmid insertion using pK18mob, not a clean deletion
A1610 carries pLpcaD: 820 bp fragment with lac promoter in pLAFR3
claims.graph_use: Permissible strain-qualified genetic process context; not direct catalysis, complex stoichiometry or a P. putida endpoint.

claims.claim: Benzoate-conditioned RT-PCR supports catB-catC cotranscription through a 309 bp intergenic amplicon. The catC-catA boundary did not amplify.
claims.graph_use: Strain-qualified expression context, no direct regulator-binding claim.

claims.claim: Benzoate increases catB transcript in A1501 and the benR insertion background; the authors leave its regulatory mechanism unresolved.
claims.level: qRT-PCR, three independent RNA samples, triplicate cDNA; 16S normalization
limits: catB measured directly; catC operon inference
No CatR orthologue identified by sequence search; no proof of regulator absence
No direct benzoate binding or BenR-to-catBC mechanism demonstrated
claims.graph_use: Optional conditional gene-expression context only if exact A1501 gene identity is available.

claims.claim: Benzoate-induced benA, catB and pcaD transcript responses differ with the accompanying carbon source.
limits: Different genes respond differently; pcaD remains strongly induced with glucose plus succinate
Crc involvement remains a hypothesis, without Crc perturbation or binding assay
claims.graph_use: Do not author a generic Crc inhibition edge or universal glucose repression edge.

locators: PDF p12 Methods, Figure4 on p6
Additional file 1 single-page panels at 0, 8, 24 h
claims.claim: Methods identifies CAT standard at 2.388 min and CCM at 3.358 min, whereas Figure4 and supplement label the approximately 2.38 min peak CCM and3.33 min peak CAT.
claims.graph_use: Do not use individual peak assignment or derived concentration as unqualified analytical proof. Samples are filtered culture supernatants, not intracellular fractions.

claims.claim: BenR-benABCD induction and benzoate/4-hydroxybenzoate culture responses concern upstream entry or broader pathway physiology.
claims.graph_use: Keep outside exact four-reaction core; no inferred transport, Crc mechanism or downstream CoA step as core membership.
